mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline (over 1 month) and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return rate is not significantly higher than 50% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.5% signals economic distress and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., positive returns occur in >40% of triggered instances), or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS rise in CPIAUCSL > 215 regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as lower output signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO decline and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 0.5% (computed from GDPC1) signals economic contraction and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 growth < 0.5% and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE increase and PAYEMS decline fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (positive returns >40%), or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 550), a positive change in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS positive change in HOUST > 550 regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.
